name: BoundDispatcher
description: Dispatcher calling functors<BoundFunctor> based on received argument type(s).

attributes.name: activated
attributes.description: Whether the engine is activated (only should be changed by the collider)

attributes.name: minSweepDistFactor
attributes.description: Minimal distance by which enlarge all bounding boxes; superseeds computed value of sweepDist when lower that (minSweepDistFactor x sweepDist). Updated by the collider. |yupdate|.

attributes.name: sweepDist
attributes.description: Distance by which enlarge all bounding boxes, to prevent collider from being run at every step (only should be changed by the collider).

methods.name: dispFunctor
methods.description: Return functor that would be dispatched for given argument(s); None if no dispatch; ambiguous dispatch throws.

methods.name: dispMatrix
methods.description: Return dictionary with contents of the dispatch matrix.
